title: Helmet Texture Fix
description: A simple resource pack that changes helmet textures in the inventory
body:
# Helmet Texture Fix
Changes vanilla helmet textures in inventory to match their appearance when equipped
- Very simple
- Also vanilla friendly

## Without resourcepack
![Without resourcepack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8fb9301c836719cd73196b6ac99cb818ba78c69e_0.webp)

## With resourcepack
![With resourcepack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e23144026e62412cd2c22a84bba77fb997f3817_0.webp)

# Compatibility
1.21 - 1.21.1 is recommended
Also works great on 1.21.1+ and should work on older versions
